name: Entropy counts microstates
statement: Entropy is the logarithm of the number of accessible microstates.

name: More microstates, more likely
statement: A macrostate is more likely when it has more microstates.

name: Why one direction
statement: A process runs one way when the reverse needs an astronomically improbable rearrangement.

name: The second law
statement: Entropy of a closed system never decreases.

name: What equilibrium is
statement: Equilibrium is the macrostate with overwhelmingly the most microstates.

name: fluctuations
statement: Small systems can fluctuate away from equilibrium.
